from pathlib import Path
import os, subprocess, json, hashlib, shutil, time
OUT = Path(__file__).parent
META = json.loads((OUT/'manifest.json').read_text())
ORDER = ['baseline','candidate','candidate','baseline','candidate','baseline','baseline','candidate']
SUITES = [
 ('handle_lookup', '^handle_lookup/(warm_same_token|distinct_tokens|rotating_65536_tokens)/(1|4|16|32)$'),
 ('handle_prepare', '^handle_prepare/(cold_miss_batch_100|cold_grow/(1000|10000)|drop/(1000|10000)|republish/10_000)$'),
 ('object_lease', '^object_lease/(pin_acquire_release_serial|final_pin_release|same_object/4|distinct_objects/4)$'),
]
records=[]
for i,variant in enumerate(ORDER):
 run=OUT/'runs'/f'{i+1:02d}-{variant}'; run.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 for name,pattern in SUITES:
  exe=META['executables'][variant][name]; frozen=Path(exe['frozen'])
  assert hashlib.sha256(frozen.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==exe['sha256']
  home=run/name; home.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  env=os.environ.copy(); env.update(CRITERION_HOME=str(home),XLFN_BENCH_MEASUREMENT_MS='1000')
  cmd=[str(frozen),'--bench',pattern,'--warm-up-time','0.2','--sample-size','30','--noplot']
  with (run/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
   subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,cwd=OUT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  found=0
  for estimates in home.rglob('new/estimates.json'):
   folder=estimates.parent; bench=json.loads((folder/'benchmark.json').read_text())
   estimate=json.loads(estimates.read_text())
   sample=json.loads((folder/'sample.json').read_text())
   records.append({'round':i+1,'variant':variant,'suite':name,'case':bench['full_id'],'estimates':estimate,'sample':sample})
   found+=1
  assert found, (variant,name)
  print(f'{i+1}/8 {variant} {name}: {found} cases',flush=True)
 # Allocation accounting stays separate from Criterion timing.
 exe=META['executables'][variant]['handle_memory']; frozen=Path(exe['frozen'])
 assert hashlib.sha256(frozen.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==exe['sha256']
 with (run/'handle_memory.jsonl').open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run([str(frozen)],cwd=OUT,stdout=log,check=True)
 (OUT/'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
print('ABBA + BAAB complete; all executable hashes checked.',flush=True)
